about.bio_intro: Hi, I'm Lígia! I'm a professional catsitter, cat rescuer, and feline behaviour enthusiast based in __CITY_NAME__.
about.bio_rescue_project: My journey with cats started long before I became a catsitter. Twelve years ago, I started an independent rescue project in my hometown in Brazil (@gatosanonimosfloripa) dedicated to helping stray cats. Since then, I've been involved in rescuing, rehabilitating, sterilising, treating and finding loving homes for more than 5,000 cats.
about.bio_continuous_learning: My knowledge doesn't come only from experience, over the years I've studied feline behaviour, health, welfare and ethical handling, and I continue to do so because cat care is constantly evolving. The more I learn, the better I can care for the cats entrusted to me.
about.bio_every_cat_different: Every cat is different, some will want to play, some will hide under the bed, and some will pretend I don't exist until snack time. My job is to respect their personality, understand their body language, and adapt my approach to what makes them feel comfortable.
about.bio_more_than_feeding: Catsitting is much more than feeding your cat and cleaning the litter box. During every visit I monitor their behaviour, appetite, litter box habits and overall wellbeing. Small changes can mean a lot, and having experience with thousands of cats helps me notice when something isn't quite right.
about.bio_experienced_with: I'm experienced with senior cats, kittens, multi-cat households, shy cats, fearful cats, post-operative care, wound care and administering medication. I always work at the cat's pace, using low-stress and respectful handling.
about.bio_photo_updates: While you're away, you'll receive plenty of photos, videos and detailed updates. As a cat mum myself, I know how difficult it is to leave them at home, so I want you to feel informed and reassured after every visit.
about.bio_water_plants: And of course, I can water your plants🪴
about.bio_behaviour_consult: I also offer feline behaviour consultations. Whether you're dealing with inappropriate scratching, litter box issues, introductions between cats or simply want to understand your cat better, I'd be happy to help.
about.bio_other_pets: I'm also happy to care for other pets! Over the years, I've looked after rabbits, guinea pigs, birds, snakes and lizards, and I genuinely enjoy getting to know different species. While every animal is unique, one thing never changes: I always take the time to learn about their specific needs and carefully follow your care instructions, so they can stick to their normal routine while you're away.
about.bio_dog_walks: And yes, I also offer dog walks! I've had dogs my entire life and have plenty of experience handling them. I'm confident walking dogs of different sizes and personalities, paying close attention to leash manners, safety, and making each walk enjoyable and stress-free for both your dog and everyone else we meet.
about.bio_closing: I hope to meet you and your pet(s) soon, and develop a long-lasting friendship while doing my best in taking care of your best friend! 🖤

reviews.verified_reviews_from_cat_owners: Verified reviews from cat owners in __CITY_NAME__
reviews.i_couldn_t_have_asked: "I couldn't have asked for a better cat sitter! Ligia took care of my baby as if it were her own, showing so much love, patience, and attention. She was incredibly attentive to my cat's needs and made sure Jazzy felt comfortable and safe. I received regular updates and could tell my cat was happy and relaxed. I highly recommend Ligia to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and professional pet sitter."
reviews.she_is_a_great_sitter: "She is a great sitter who makes sure your cats are well taken care of. She sends pics/videos every visit and even though one of my cats is VERY shy, she was able to pet and bond with them a little. If you need an experienced and kind sitter, I would for sure recommend her!"
reviews.l_gia_was_great_with: "Lígia was great with my dog. She was very friendly, easy to communicate with, and always responsive. She took good care of her, spent time playing with her, and kept me updated with photos. It was so clear she gives real attention and care. I would happily book her again and definitely recommend her."
